newsitem.title: UK: British mass murderer West's brother found dead.
newsitem.headline: British mass murderer West's brother found dead.

text.p: John West, brother of mass murderer Fred West, was found dead in the garage of his home on Thursday just hours before the end of his trial on rape charges.
The retired dustman, whose death was a macabre echo of his brother's suicide, had been on trial accused of raping Fred West's daughter and another girl.
He too is believed to have committed suicide and police said there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding his death in the western English town of Gloucester.
John West had been accused of repeatedly raping his niece, Anne Marie West, from the age of 10.

Fred West was found dead in his prison cell on New Year's Day 1995 while awaiting trial for the murder of 12 women and young girls. His wife Rosemary was tried on 10 counts of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment.
